top_phrases: lets mde ui test a matching message class against the whole list of message classes instead of only the individual message class
adds a natural key to metadata instances for business friendly retrieval and centralized shared instance management
enables user defined data clustering logic in bigquery and row key generation in bigtable for the federation api
links types to metadata buckets and can require record contextualization with specific bucket metadata
provides a file based configuration package system for atomic deployments and gitops integration
provides a standalone ui for manufacturing data engine deployment without manufacturing connect
adds the mde data mde dimension and mde system datasets to improve data table governance
adds custom whistle functions to look up metadata instances in parsers by natural key
extends the bigquery schema with new fields to better support analytics use cases
allows deletion of mde entities and configuration packages for development use
adds more granular deployment sizes to support varied deployment scenarios
exports configuration data to dedicated tables in the mde system dataset
provides common mde lookml components and configuration packages
adds a pub sub sink for extensibility and custom integration
supports messages in both json and protobuf
introduces a shared cache using redis
